messages:
jessica-cs: customer reports wallet banner shows $200 trial credit in the dashboard but their service key calls are still returning billing errors.

sam-support: ah — any account + service key we can test with?

jessica-cs: acct: acme-784, service_key: sk-live-abc123. customer pasted this curl and response:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-abc123" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{"error":"billing_required","message":"no credits available for service key"}
```
Console screenshot: wallet banner at top-right shows "$200 trial credit — expires 2026-04-02".

kevin-billing: pulling ledger for acme-784. I can see promo event delivered on 2026-03-10 and org_balance=200.00 USD. But scanning project mappings — the promo landed on the org, and our promo-runner wrote credits to project_new_456, while this service key is still attached to project_legacy_123 (migration artifact).

marta-eng: sounds like a mapping drift during org/project migration. When an org-level credit exists but the service key is attached to a legacy project with no credit, API billing will still block. We should either surface that in the UI or ensure keys get re-linked.

sam-support: can we resync credits so the project picks it up automatically?

ops-bot: admin.resyncCredits(org_id=acme-784) started by @marta-eng — job id job-8842. Estimated 60s.

billing-bot: promo_applied event processed. Ledger: org_credit_balance=200.00 USD. Projects updated: project_new_456=200.00, project_legacy_123=0.00.

kevin-billing: confirmed. The service key still references project_legacy_123. We need to either remap the key to project_new_456 or move the credit to the legacy project. Which does customer prefer?

jessica-cs: asked customer for permission to remap internally. they replied OK to remap.

marta-eng: remapping now: reassign service_key sk-live-abc123 -> project_new_456. Clearing key cache and triggering metering refresh.

ops-bot: cache purge + metering refresh completed for sk-live-abc123 (job job-8842-complete). Next request should be billed against project_new_456 balance.

jessica-cs: customer ran a test request and reports 200 OK and console now shows usage deducted from trial balance.

sam-support: great — closing thread after 24h verification. please reopen if it recurs.

kevin-billing: filing follow-up action item: add alert when org_credit_balance > 0 and the majority of active service_keys are attached to projects with zero credit. Also validate promo pipeline to backfill/notify on project mapping during org migrations.

jessica-cs: thanks everyone :tada:

marta-eng: :thumbsup:
